title: pathlib paths
text: The pathlib module supplies object oriented filesystem paths. A Path can join child names with the slash operator. Path read_text reads a text file and write_text writes text using an encoding. Use Path exists to test whether a path is present.

title: json serialization
text: The json module serializes Python objects into JSON text. json dumps returns a JSON string while json dump writes JSON to a file like object. json loads parses a JSON string and json load reads JSON from a file like object.

title: itertools iteration tools
text: The itertools module provides iterator building blocks. itertools chain joins multiple iterables into one stream. itertools islice selects a slice from an iterator without first constructing a list. itertools product produces the cartesian product of input iterables.

title: collections containers
text: The collections module includes specialized container datatypes. Counter counts hashable values. defaultdict calls a factory to supply a default value for a missing key. deque provides efficient appends and pops from either end.

title: argparse command lines
text: The argparse module creates command line interfaces. An ArgumentParser describes positional arguments and optional flags. Calling parse_args reads command line arguments and returns a namespace containing the parsed values.
